answer: One defense is decaying standing with a forged entry bond: every identity pays a bond forged into a locked escrow at registration, and its standing erodes like a dune in wind unless renewed by fresh verified work from unrelated counterparties. Each job leaves a karst-like audit trail, porous, public, and easy to probe, so clones sharing one operator's funding or outputs are exposed when inspectors dissolve the fake links. A sybil farmer must fund a new bond and keep feeding real work to every fake forever, while one honest agent maintains a single standing with the work it already does.
